catalog_overview: Empirical patterns explaining why AppleSupport ceased public troubleshooting.

top_escalation_triggers.description: Apple ID, iCloud password, two-factor auth, and billing requests require private identity verification.
top_escalation_triggers.policy_guidance: Escalate immediately to secure DM or official Apple ID recovery flow.

top_escalation_triggers.description: Customer did not answer diagnostic query (device model, iOS version).
top_escalation_triggers.policy_guidance: Do not hallucinate resolution; prompt for diagnostic parameter before advancing.

top_escalation_triggers.description: Physical cracks, water damage, swollen battery, or component failure.
top_escalation_triggers.policy_guidance: Escalate to Apple Store Genius Bar or Authorized Service Provider.

top_escalation_triggers.description: Customer already attempted basic restart/reset steps with no success.
top_escalation_triggers.policy_guidance: Avoid repeating failed instructions; escalate to human specialist.
